description: Change of use of Office to Restaurant/Cafe at Unit 1 to facilitate enlargement of existing Restaurant/Cafe at Unit 2
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (DOC/PLAN/03/2, Received: 30/10/2017, Planning Statement, Unnumbered Location Plan, KHAN/PLAN/005, Received: 20/07/2020, Delivery and Servicing Management Plan, Received: 11/09/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved must be implemented in accordance with the approved cycle storage details under application 00667/1-3/P4(4).

Condition : 4 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the submitted Delivery and Servicing Management Plan and must be implemented throughout the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 5 - The refuse and recyclable waste materials from the premises shall be separated and stored in closed storage bins in the bin storage area shown on the approved plans and no such material shall be stored outside the site or other than in the designated area.  Non-recyclable and perishable waste shall be removed from site no less frequently than once a week.  Waste shall be removed from the site to a suitable enclosed private storage area or an authorised refuse disposal or recycling site as soon as the bins become full if this is earlier than the time of the normal collection, unless additional covered and enclosed bins (as described above) have been provided and are thereafter made permanently available for the on-site storage of refuse and waste.
